title: zega graph-component contract, format 1 (APS 21)
description: What a graph component accepts. Data arrives as rows (optionally inside groups) of a ZQL result; each role reads one field per row, per group or per result, typed in ZQL's value vocabulary. Surface parameters and display options are settings: a JSON Schema from the published keyword subset below, plus a default. Agents and the /components gallery read this file; the runtime validates view specs against it.

format.description: The contract format major. A breaking change to this schema is format 2.

version.description: The component's semver. Major: an existing view spec may stop binding. Minor: something added (a role, an option). Patch: rendering only.

surface.description: The surface this component draws on, e.g. "map".

minRows.description: The fewest rows a group must have (e.g. 2 for a path).

groups.description: Whether the rows may come in groups (e.g. several paths, each with its own label). Without a `groups` binding the whole result is one group.

roles.description: Data roles by name. `rows` and `groups` are reserved (they are the binding's structure).

sample.description: A .zql file (schema + data) the examples' ZQL runs against.

zql.description: The query whose result the examples bind.

valueType.description: ZQL's value vocabulary. Point: {lat, lon}. Float: any finite number (Ints included). Int: a whole number. Bool, String. Enum: a String from the role's `enum`. XY: {x, y} in the role's planar `frame` (a rink, a court, a field).

per.description: Where the role is read: a field of each row, of each group, or of the result.

shape.description: One value (the default), a list of values, or a list of lists.

minimum.description: For Float and Int (and each coordinate of XY).

enum.description: The allowed values of an Enum role.

frame.description: An XY role's planar frame, e.g. "rink", "field".

relativeTo.description: An XY role measured from a reference point: the name of the surface parameter that holds it (e.g. "los").

setting.description: One surface parameter or option: a JSON Schema limited to exactly these keywords (the ones schema.js interprets), plus its default.

format.description: lonlat-bounds: [west, south, east, north] with west < east and south < north.

error.description: The first teaching error the validator gives, exactly (code, at, message, help, fix).
